title: Core Quartet #22
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long teased neon pink and lime hair, a bold cheeky grin, bold and confident, curly hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, holographic finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme cobalt platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, long black hair in twin tails with pink and black ribbons under a blunt fringe, a hollow, half-lidded expression, bold and confident, curly hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern — a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, wide cream bands following every deep crease, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.

Left woman's footwear: extreme cream platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, hair set in glossy voluminous old-film waves, a poised, glamorous expression, demure and soft, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease, dense dense scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.

Right woman's footwear: extreme mother-of-pearl platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Ukrainian woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, long light-brown hair in a thick braid over one shoulder, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, sultry, curly hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Croatian Hvar lace-inspired linework — an ivory ground with fine cream and gold lace-like filigree, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense lace-like filigree filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto corset-lace boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 4, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
